fox_queen: the Nine-Tailed Fox Queen, the chapter-2 villain who lures guardians to her side: a fox-spirit creature with a real fox head (pointed muzzle, narrow sly eyes, ivory fur face) on a small stylized upright body, NOT a human woman with fox ears; a deep plum and ink-indigo hanbok robe, nine distinct full tails fanned behind her with pale jade foxfire tips, a folded fan held near a knowing grin, a small ornamental binyeo hairpin between the ears; elegant and dangerous
dragon_king: Yongwang, the Dragon King of the East Sea, chapter-3 villain: a broad dragon-headed sovereign with a long whiskered snout, celadon scales and a coiled tail, wearing sea-green court robes edged with wave patterns, a coral and nacre crown, one clawed hand raising a glowing yeouiju pearl; imposing and proud, Korean sea-palace style, not a Chinese imperial dragon
death_emissary: the Lord Reaper of the Underworld (저승왕 사자), chapter-4 villain: a gaunt figure in a flowing black durumagi coat and an oversized black gat hat, pale mask-like face with narrow jade eyes, one hand holding an unrolled scroll of names and the other a heavy iron chain, a paper lantern glowing pale jade at the belt; solemn and chilling, never gory
three_god_destroyer: the Destroyer of the Three Gods (삼신 파괴자), chapter-5 villain: a hulking mountain-stone giant whose body is cracked relic rock bound with frayed shaman rope, three broken spirit-talisman masks hanging from its chest, cracked brass shaman bells on its wrists, ember light seeping from the seams, raising one enormous fist; monumental and wrathful
eternal_emperor: the Undying Eternal Emperor, chapter-6 villain: a small gaunt ancient king who refuses death, dried grey-jade skin, wearing a Silla-style gold crown with tree-shaped uprights and dangling jade gogok comma beads, a heavy gold-brocade royal robe gone dusty and torn at the hem, a bronze ceremonial sword planted before him; regal, cold and ancient, not Chinese imperial
god_emperor: Cheonje, the Heavenly Emperor and chapter-7 final boss: a radiant celestial sovereign in layered white and pale-gold cloud-sleeve robes, a sun-disc halo behind the head, holding the three heavenly seals — a bronze mirror, a short bronze sword and a bronze bell — floating around one open hand, stern serene face; majestic and severe, not a winged angel
primordial_titan: the Primordial Titan (원초신), chapter-8 final boss: a colossal ancient creation giant formed of layered earth, cracked relic stone and old tree roots, starlight and ember glowing in the deep cracks, a crown of broken standing stones, one arm lifting a boulder-sized seed of light; asymmetrical monumental mass, awe-inspiring rather than monstrous
void_sovereign: the Void Sovereign (공허 군주), chapter-9 final boss: a crowned lord of the void whose robe dissolves into ink-glass shards and starry darkness at the edges, a hollow porcelain mask with thin violet cracks, a broken dark-crystal crown floating above the head, long sleeves spreading like torn night; controlled inner gaps in the silhouette, ominous and elegant, not a black blob
